name: design-qa
description: PostToolUse hook on Write/Edit of image (`.png`/`.svg`/`.jpg`/`.jpeg`) and CSS (`.css`/`.scss`/`.module.css`) files. **Image checks: emptiness, SVG XML validity + hardcoded colors + viewBox + title, PNG/JPG dimensions + 4M-pixel threshold + logo blurry warning. CSS checks: hardcoded colors vs tokens, hardcoded pixels, `!important` abuse, missing `prefers-reduced-motion`, no responsive breakpoints.**
